item.title: Lemon Angel
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fairy Dust Co., Ltd., C-Class
  • 発売日: 1995-07-21
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: レモンエンジェル
  • 英語名: Lemon Angel

あらすじ

The protagonist of Lemon Angel is Tomo, a high school student. The plot involves Tomo meeting her friends Erika and Miki, only to become trapped in a magical dimension with her friends gone. Tomo must travel to various worlds in order to find them; these worlds have varied themes and settings, including an alien attack on a spaceship, a country populated by giant sexually abusive mushrooms, a realm that changes Tomo’s gender, etc.
